獲獎

情境圖中的茶具、茶點與佈置物僅作展示，禮盒內容請見上方規格。盒色與款式請見本頁選項。

一盒風景，一席茶時

先看盒面的紋理，再看金魚的摺痕。從指尖的手作到水中的舒展，每一件小物都邀請人放慢觀看的步調。禮盒被打開之後，藝術也隨著共飲的時刻，走進生活。

茶款介紹
TEA / 01
01
玫瑰烏龍茶

取台灣南投新鮮有機玫瑰花瓣，搭配嚴選烏龍茶胚。金黃琥珀茶湯，蘊遞醇美玫瑰香氣，滋味甘醇，喉韻悠長。

TEA / 02
02
東方美人茶

茶小綠葉蟬吸食嫩芽而形成「著涎」，茶香帶有天然花果蜜香，口感醇厚甘潤。

TEA / 03
03
紅玉紅茶

紅玉是台灣特有的茶樹品種。茶湯明亮清澈、朱紅豔麗，滋味濃醇甘潤，帶有天然肉桂、薄荷與淡淡花香。

TEA / 04
04
金萱烏龍茶

茶湯金黃明亮、水色澄清，微焙醇和並帶天然乳香，口感甘醇生津，茶性溫潤柔和。

TEA / 05
05
玫瑰蜜香紅茶

蜜香紅茶中加入有機玫瑰花瓣，玫瑰濃郁甜美，與天然甘醇的蜜香紅茶相伴。

150 mL
95°C
約 5 分鐘

美好的

沖泡方式
注入熱水

將 150 mL（約 5 fl oz）、95°C（203°F）的熱水倒入杯中。建議使用透明玻璃杯，欣賞小金魚的姿態。

打開包裝

沿著缺口將包裝完整撕開，取出小金魚茶包。

放入小金魚

將茶包放入水中。可用茶匙或攪拌棒輕輕將茶包壓入水中，再讓它浮起。

浸泡

浸泡約 5 分鐘，看茶色漸漸加深，小金魚慢慢成形。

享用

聞一聞茶香，啜飲一口，為自己留一段時間。

About the teas
TEA / 01
01
Rose Oolong Tea

Carefully selected oolong leaves meet organic rose petals from Nantou, Taiwan. The tea brews to a golden amber, with a mellow rose fragrance, a smooth flavor and a lingering finish.

TEA / 02
02
Oriental Beauty Tea

Oriental Beauty develops its distinctive aroma as tea leafhoppers feed on the young buds. It has natural notes of honey, fruit and flowers, with a rich, smooth sweetness.

TEA / 03
03
Ruby Black Tea

Ruby is a Taiwanese tea cultivar. It brews to a clear, vivid red, with a rich, smooth flavor and natural notes of cinnamon, mint and delicate flowers.

TEA / 04
04
Jin Xuan Tea

Lightly roasted and mellow, Jin Xuan brews to a clear, golden hue with a naturally milky aroma. Its smooth, refreshing flavor makes for a gentle cup.

TEA / 05
05
Rose & Honey-Scented Black Tea

Organic rose petals bring a rich floral fragrance to honey-scented black tea, complementing its naturally mellow sweetness.

150 mL · 5 fl oz
95°C · 203°F
About 5 minutes

A beautiful

way to brew
Pour the Hot Water

Pour 150 mL (about 5 fl oz) of hot water at 95°C (203°F) into your cup. Use a clear glass cup to enjoy the goldfish's shape.

Open the Package

Tear the package fully open at the notch and lift out the goldfish tea bag.

Add Your Goldfish

Add the tea bag to the water. Using a teaspoon or stirrer, gently submerge the tea bag, then let it float.

Steep

Steep for about 5 minutes as the tea's color deepens and the goldfish takes shape.

Enjoy

Enjoy the fragrance, take a sip, and make a little time for yourself.
